description: This file defines a class 'SocketSender' responsible for asynchronously sending data over a network socket using the .NET Socket API. It handles both single-buffer and multi-buffer (ReadOnlySequence) data transmissions, utilizing PipeScheduler and PipeAwaitableEventArgs for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: SocketSender
classes.description: Sealed class that manages asynchronous data transmission over a socket, supporting both single and multiple buffer sequences.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SocketSender with a socket and scheduler.

methods.description: Public method to send data asynchronously, accepting a ReadOnlySequence of bytes.

methods.description: Private helper method to send a single ReadOnlyMemory<byte> asynchronously.

methods.description: Private method that converts a ReadOnlySequence of bytes into a list of ArraySegment<byte> for multi-buffer sending.
